in_marathi.name: Sukhveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukhveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sukh', which means happiness, and 'veer' meaning warrior. Sukhveer is a name for a brave and joyful man.
